levels.name: Adeptus' Tutelage
levels.description: When White Jade Radishes explode, active characters within their AoE will gain 15% Dendro DMG Bonus for 8s and have 15 Stamina restored to them. This form of Stamina Restoration can only be triggered every 5s.

levels.name: Innocent
levels.description: While affected by the Adeptal Legacy state caused by Moonjade Descent, if White Jade Radish explosions damage opponents, 3 Energy will be restored to Yaoyao. This form of Energy regeneration can occur once every 0.8s.

levels.name: Loyal and Kind
levels.description: Increases the Level of Raphanus Sky Cluster by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Winsome
levels.description: After using Raphanus Sky Cluster or Moonjade Descent, Yaoyao's Elemental Mastery will be increased based on 0.3% of her Max HP for 8s. The maximum Elemental Mastery she can gain this way is 120.

levels.name: Compassionate
levels.description: Increases the Level of Moonjade Descent by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Beneficent
levels.description: For every 2 White Jade Radishes Yuegui: Throwing Mode throws out, it will also throw a Mega Radish that will have a larger AoE than the standard White Jade Radish and have the following effects upon exploding: Deals AoE Dendro DMG based on 75% of Yaoyao's ATK. Restores HP for the active character based on 7.5% of Yaoyao's Max HP. Every Yuegei: Throwing Mode can throw out a maximum of 2 Mega Radishes.
